content_sections.heading: ESIC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 02 of 2026 gives the full conditions for each post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ESIC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining. Candidates working in Govt/Autonomous/Statutory Institution must submit NOC at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for ESIC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates on deputation are not accepted. Candidates without verified documents are not allowed into the interview.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Fixed basic pay plus admissible allowances as per ESIC Headquarters norms; transport allowance with DA is also given. Initial period of 1 year, extendable up to 3 years total subject to satisfactory performance and institutional requirements. Contract terminates upon the joining of a regular faculty or incumbent, or attainment of maximum age limit.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Through Demand Draft in favor of 'ESI Fund A/c No. 1' payable at Bhubaneswar.

content_sections.heading: How Will ESIC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Document verification by the Document Verification Committee Interview conducted by the duly constituted selection board based on academic credentials and performance Academic credentials and performance in interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certificate of passing Class 10th for Date of Birth All Marks Sheets, Attempt, Degree Certificate of MBBS Valid EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwBD Certificate State/NMC Medical Registration Certificate (updated) Proof of Publication(s) Experience Certificate Recent Passport Size Photograph of Candidate Relieving/NOC from previous/current Employer

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the Google Form in advance online using the link provided in the notification. Bring a printout of the completed offline application form along with self-attested copies of required documents and demand draft on the date of interview. Attend on 17 November 2026, reporting at 9:00 AM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates reporting after 10:00 AM on the interview date will be considered absent.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 75 vacancies: 12 Anaesthesiology, 2 Biochemistry, 4 Microbiology, 2 Chest (Pulm. Med.), 3 Dermatology, 4 Eye (Ophthalmology) and 11 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 17 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: SC / ST / ESIC (Regular Employees) / Female Candidate / Defence Ex-Servicemen & PH Candidates: Nil. All Other Categories: Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fixed basic pay plus allowances. Professor: Rs.2,60,972, Associate Professor: Rs.1,67,056, Assistant Professor & Senior Resident: Rs.1,43,524.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS, MD/MS/DNB/Other relevant post-graduate qualification as per NMC norms. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining. Candidates working in Govt/Autonomous/Statutory Institution must submit NOC at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates on deputation are not accepted. Candidates without verified documents are not allowed into the interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Document verification by the Document Verification Committee. Interview conducted by the duly constituted selection board based on academic credentials and performance. Academic credentials and performance in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial period of 1 year, extendable up to 3 years total subject to satisfactory performance and institutional requirements. Contract terminates upon the joining of a regular faculty or incumbent, or attainment of maximum age limit.
